what_i_found: Tidebreak makes the racing line a choice between speed, shared supplies and surviving three damaging hits. Braking into reverse, skimming a ramp edge, or spending a shield can preserve a run through flooded industrial circuits. Nitro canisters give a short automatic burst without spending the manual boost reserve, while every rival competes for the same finite supplies.
